Data Engineer – 3 month contract
London, fully remote
£400 per day, outside IR35

Aldgate Consulting is looking for a data engineer to help a retail client move reporting from spreadsheets to a warehouse. You'll be working with Python, dbt and BigQuery, and you'll need solid SQL. Some Airflow experience would help. The client team works in two-week sprints and expects you to join their daily stand-up.

Start date: as soon as possible.
